name: @openwa/desktop
description: OpenWA Desktop — Electron app embedding the Baileys engine for local, single-user use.

scripts.dev: echo 'desktop dev requires an Electron install; see README'

//: Electron, electron-builder, electron-updater, and better-sqlite3 are declared as optional peerDependencies because they require native rebuilds that can't run in every developer environment (e.g. dev containers). Install them locally with `bun add -d electron electron-builder electron-updater better-sqlite3` before running `bun run dev`.
